ankha.appearance: Ankha moves through the island like royalty from another age — a navy cat banded in gold, with eyeliner drawn wide in the manner of ancient Egyptian queens. Wings of liner sweep from the outer corners of her eyes, and when she blinks you catch a warm flash of orange shadow beneath. Her large black pupils tilt upward, and her mouth holds a regal scowl even on cheerful days. A golden cobra rises from her brow, striped in blue, completing a silhouette that feels less like costume than birthright. In earlier outings she sometimes wore a scarab pendant instead of the full headdress, though the cobra crown returned in later years.
ankha.personality: Ankha's snooty streak runs deep, and she wears it with the confidence of someone who believes poise and presentation matter. She can sound vain or sharp at first, commenting on looks, fitness, and taste with little filter. Island life softened her older islander edge — she still wants admiration, but warmth slips through when talk stays respectful. Criticize her style or suggest she skip a workout, though, and she bristles fast; jocks and Ankha in the same conversation often end with someone stomping off. Lazy neighbors unsettle her with their love of snacks and naps, and peppy villagers draw her gossip and side-eye over small habits she finds undignified. Normal, cranky, and fellow snooty villagers tend to suit her better: shared bluntness, fashion talk, and a tolerance for drama. Keep showing up with mature conversation and she gradually confides in you, still regal, still a little catty, but genuinely fond. She cares deeply about being well-liked as well as well-dressed, and praise that feels sincere lands better than flattery she did not earn.

apollo.appearance: Apollo is a bald eagle in miniature: charcoal body feathers, a crisp white head, yellow beak and talons, and pale claws that look ready to grip a perch.
apollo.personality: Apollo's cranky temperament reads as maturity first — gravel in the voice, little patience for nonsense, and a habit of sounding blunt even when he means well. Peppy neighbors wear him out with their sparkle; he mutters about them to anyone who will listen. Normal and snooty villagers suit his pace better, and he finds easy rapport with other cranky types over quiet, pointed talk. He even respects lazy villagers for how calmly they live, though his sharp tongue can still prick a gentle normal villager now and then. Give him time and steady kindness — favors, daily chats, showing up when asked — and the wall thins. He starts treating you like a real confidant, the one person worth opening up to. His hobbies skew toward peace rather than competition: music gear in the house, long pauses, no need to win. Stand on the beach with him on a clear day and he may grow wistful, the sea pulling up memories of parents and a youth he rarely discusses. Island gossip links him to Whitney and blue roses left at a doorstep; whether romance or rumor, it fits a bird who guards his softer side. Under the gruff exterior is loyalty that does not announce itself — a stoic eagle who would rather brood than beg for friendship, yet keeps it fiercely once earned.

audie.appearance: Audie glows fox-bright despite being a wolf — orange fur washed pale gold along her snout, hands, feet, and tail tip. White sunglasses with purple lenses rest on her forehead like a permanent vacation mood. Teal lines the inside of her ears; blonde hair sweeps to one side. Her blue eyes carry long lashes and a sweep of yellow shadow, and her catchphrase nods to the foxlike silhouette she wears so easily.
audie.personality: Audie radiates peppy sunshine — quick compliments, little gifts, and a smile that fills the plaza. Her attention jumps fast; she can overreact to small slights, and snooty or cranky villagers sometimes read her enthusiasm as rude. Lazy neighbors can feel like a mismatch, while jocks get her cheer in return — she treats their energy like a dance partner. Normal, big sister, and smug villagers round out her circle with ease. Befriending her is straightforward: show up, match her warmth, and she settles into the villagers she trusts most. She forgives fast, forgets arguments quickly, and keeps the island feeling like a party that never quite ends.

bea.appearance: Bea is a soft brown dog with a muddy-toned muzzle, half-lidded eyes ringed in matching brown, and dark brown ears. Her fore and hind paws darken at the tips, as if she wandered through wet earth and kept the memory.
bea.personality: Bea greets the world with normal-villager grace — polite, sweet, and a little shy until trust settles in. Early talks feel gentle and reserved; friendship turns her outward and chatty. She takes unkind words to heart and can grow sad if bullied, the way many kind villagers do. Once she knows you, her warmth is steady: easy hellos, soft concern, and a presence that makes a new island feel homier.

beau.appearance: Beau looks like he wandered out of a sunlit savanna — bright orange fur, black-tipped ears and hooves, and striped antlers that catch the light. White rings circle his eyes above peach lids; a white snout and brown nose finish a face made for lazy afternoon naps.
beau.personality: Beau lives at an unhurried pace and greets neighbors with easy friendliness. Food and gentle humor pepper his chats; he can sound naïve without ever feeling unkind. Peppy, smug, and cranky villagers usually get along with him, while snooty and jock personalities chafe against his relaxed routines. He turns in around eleven at night and rises at eight, ready for another slow, snack-friendly day.

bob.appearance: Bob is a lavender cat dotted in deeper purple spots, with half-closed lazy yellow eyes and pale purple paws. Pink fills the inside of his ears, and his tail stripes alternate purple shades like a cozy quilt.
bob.personality: Bob's lazy rhythm makes every day feel unhurried — friendly hellos, food on the mind, and humor that lands softly. He meshes well with peppy, smug, and cranky neighbors, though snooty and jock villagers may side-eye his snack-and-nap lifestyle. Sleep finds him at eleven; he wakes at eight with the same mellow energy that made him a fan favorite for decades.

cherry.appearance: Cherry is a bold red dog with teal eyes and a gray ring around her left one. Black ears frame a purple nose; white markings on her left ear read like stud earrings. Her torso and legs run black against red arms and tail, with black paws anchoring the look. Six lashes line each eye — three above, three below — and her smile curves slightly to the left even at rest.
cherry.personality: Cherry brings big-sister energy — protective, blunt, and ready with advice whether you asked or not. She treats the player like a younger sibling, offering tips on everything from gifts to island etiquette. Gossip and rumor-mongering rub her wrong; snooty and cranky villagers who trade in that talk get short shrift. Jocks and lazy neighbors fit her easygoing hobbies, and most villagers find her tomboy warmth approachable. She speaks her mind without much filter, but the care underneath is genuine.

chrissy.appearance: Chrissy is a white rabbit in a pink polka-dot hood, blonde fringe peeking out, green nose, and pink blush on her cheeks. Two pink lashes sit low on each eye; black eyes hold white sparkles that flash pink when she is shocked. She mirrors Francine in silhouette — pink where her sister wears blue, different eyes — and wears a smile so often it feels like her default expression.
chrissy.personality: Chrissy bubbles with peppy voltage — excitable, rarely discouraged, and always ready to bounce out of her house. She overreacts to tiny stakes, especially competitions; ask her about clothing or furniture and she may need something specific to enter one. Fossils fascinate her, and she often requests one for her collection because she loves the hunt. Pink, she insists, suits her best, and she says so often enough that neighbors smile and nod. Arguments with snooty villagers turn sharp; she may blame the player for tastes she dislikes and rage rather than sulk when cranky or snooty neighbors tease her. Jocks do not mock her eating habits — she keeps meals modest — but peppy openness still clashes with snooty barbs and name-calling. Jock, lazy, normal, and fellow peppy villagers tend to accept her open-minded cheer; cranky and snooty types stir drama she refuses to swallow quietly. Her attention span is short: unfinished tasks and old spats slip from memory fast, though she rarely stays discouraged from hobbies she loves. Stay friendly and she remains a starry-eyed neighbor who treats the island like a runway and a playground at once, forever smiling unless someone insults her favorite color.

coco.appearance: Coco looks sculpted from warm clay — a tan rabbit with hollow, gyroid-like eyes and mouth, legs slightly darker than her body. A seam rings the top of her head like folded pottery, and her face stays eerily blank even when she is delighted; only surprise widens those empty eyes a little, giving the faintest hint of life beneath the stillness.
coco.personality: Coco's normal personality reads shy and caring beneath an unsettling exterior. She gets along with villagers of every type, yet frets over housekeeping — visit her home and she may apologize for mess she alone notices. Letters and reading matter to her; she mentions titles she loves and delights in mail. The blank expression belies a gentle neighbor who values quiet kindness.

diana.appearance: Diana is a pale deer with pink cheeks, pinkish-purple hair, and a black nose that anchors her refined face. Her hooves blush pink with pale blue cuffs; inner ears wash light blue with the same purple at the edges, and pink tips finish each ear like careful makeup.
diana.personality: Diana's snooty polish shows up as confidence that can sound rude before friendship forms — talk turns to her experiences, her look, her standards. Mature, non-insulting conversation earns warmer replies; she may still comment on other villagers' fashion, especially among normal, peppy, big sister, and snooty neighbors. Jocks and lazy villagers clash with her lifestyle, stirring anger or discomfort when food and fitness dominate chat. Cranky and smug types share gossip and style talk she appreciates, swapping notes on appearances and habits with relish. Over time she confides personal feelings while keeping a subtle edge — elegance with a sharp tongue never fully filed down, though trusted neighbors hear a softer Diana beneath the poise.

dom.appearance: Dom is a cream-wool sheep with coral-pink skin, white hooves, and horns striped in pale crimson and pink. Large black eyes hold twin white glints, and his mouth curves like a tiny numeral three — earnest, bright, impossible to miss on the plaza.
dom.personality: Dom burns with jock enthusiasm — fitness, sports, and friendly brags about reps and runs. He compliments effort and may nudge the player about workouts with a grin, not malice, commenting on stamina the way others comment on weather. Peppy and smug villagers match his energy; snooty neighbors bristle at fitness critiques, and cranky villagers tire of his hype and loud optimism. While often friendly, his hyper personality can grate on quieter types until they learn he means well. He sleeps around half past midnight and rises at half past six, already stretching for the day with tie-dye confidence and sheepish charm.

erik.appearance: Erik is a brown deer with beige hooves, a light brown snout, and short bangs above white eyes and black pupils. Moose-like antlers crown a sturdy, northern look — more forest edge than pampered garden.
erik.personality: Erik's cranky gruffness hides a slow thaw — blunt at first, warmer after steady friendship. He shares the mature, sometimes insensitive edge common to cranky villagers, yet opens up when treated kindly. Peppy sparkle annoys him; normal and snooty neighbors suit him better, and he respects lazy villagers' calm. Give him time and he treats the player like someone worth honest talk.

fang.appearance: Fang is a cool gray wolf with a white muzzle, cream-tipped paws, and purple eyelids. Purple lines the inside of his mouth and ears; in earlier games his fur ran slightly lighter and his eyes larger, with brown lids instead of purple.
fang.personality: Fang's cranky mood shows as grump and distance early on. Keep showing up with patience and the frost melts — close friendship is possible for neighbors who respect his pace.

fauna.appearance: Fauna is a gentle brown deer with orange on her face and limbs, red cheek spots, and bright pink inner ears. Light-brown flecks dot the back of her head; yellow hooves complete a woodland palette that feels autumn-soft.
fauna.personality: Fauna's normal warmth reads shy and caring — easy hellos, broad compatibility with every personality, and quiet worry about a home that never looks tidy enough to her. She loves reading and mentions books often; letters delight her whether sending or receiving. Visit her house and she may blush over imagined mess, inviting you in anyway with soft hospitality.

genji.appearance: Genji is a snow-white rabbit with mahogany ears that band brown around his head, pink cheeks, and chocolate-tipped paws, feet, and tail while the rest stays bright white. Pale blue eyes sit wide open — triangular when angry — under small round black brows, a crisp silhouette that feels both martial and cute on the plaza path.
genji.personality: Genji carries jock fire — workouts, sports talk, and proud notes about staying fit. He is friendly to the player yet may comment on exercise habits with a competitive grin, bragging about reps the way others brag about catches. Peppy and smug villagers share his spark; snooty neighbors take offense at fitness jabs, and cranky villagers groan at his volume and endless energy. While often encouraging, he can sound boastful until you know his earnest streak. He turns in after midnight and wakes at half past six, already eager to move through another active day.

goldie.appearance: Goldie resembles a Golden Retriever in villager form — golden fur with beige patches on muzzle, paws, feet, tail, and ears, plus a beige spot by her left eye. Her eyes are oblong, brown around the sclera with bright white pupils.
goldie.personality: Goldie's normal kindness feels motherly — she asks how she can help and means it. Hobbies interest her without obsession; she stays neutral and gentle about fishing, fashion, or furniture. Favors make her anxious to impose; she apologizes for asking and rarely angers, though sadness comes easily. Cranky villagers test her patience; snooty neighbors can too. Friendship takes patience — photos and close trust arrive after many kind visits. She rises at five in the morning and sleeps at one, early bird in every sense. Like many normal villagers she may request specific clothing to collect, rewarding loyal helpers with her picture over time. Her sensitivity is the through-line: a golden dog who wants everyone comfortable, even when that means swallowing her own worry.

judy.appearance: Judy is a bear cub washed in ice-blue fur that fades to pastel pink across her body, with a white face, rosy cheeks, small black nose, and V-shaped mouth. White paw pads dot her feet; a round white tail and cream inner ears soften the palette. Cyan shadow and thick black lashes frame dark purple starry eyes — when shocked they flash white with a tiny purple iris and wrinkle lines; when closed, sparkles still glimmer on her lashes like quiet constellations.
judy.personality: Judy's snooty chic arrives with polish that can sound belittling — fashion critiques, dress sense barbs, an uptown tone that stings before friendship forms. Cranky, big sister, smug, and fellow snooty villagers match her wavelength; jocks question her fitness and normal villagers' relentless kindness can grate on her sharper edges. Beneath the edge is someone who cares about aesthetics and respect in equal measure, softening slowly for neighbors who meet her standards.

ketchup.appearance: Ketchup is a tomato-red duck — orange beak and cheeks, black legs, and green leaf-like hair above a yellow belly with lime-green wing tips. Every line of her design reads picnic-sweet, from seasonings to stem, name and silhouette aligned like a farm-stand label.
ketchup.personality: Ketchup sparkles with peppy cheer, easy friendship, and bursts of emotion over small things that fade as quickly as they flare. Snooty and cranky barbs sting; she may feel insulted when fashion or gossip turns sharp. Lazy neighbors can feel awkward in conversation, while jocks, smug villagers, big sister types, and fellow peppy neighbors keep her bouncing with shared energy. Short memory for slights, long memory for kindness — she settles quickly into the villagers she trusts and rewards them with gifts and compliments.

lolly.appearance: Lolly is a blue-gray tabby with a big round head and no visible nose — black ears, stripes along arms, tail, head sides, back, and top, softened to dark gray in New Horizons. Pink and light pink fill her inner ears; white tips her paws and a circular white muzzle. Her mouth forms a tiny three; eyes echo the number six, flipping to nines when she looks up toward the sky above her.
lolly.personality: Lolly's normal sweetness runs sensitive — kind, easily hurt by lazy or cranky teasing, devoted to fashion, bugs, fish, and furniture hobbies that keep her gently busy. She welcomes visitors though she may ask you to ignore clutter she alone sees, sharing that worry with other normal neighbors who fuss over tidiness. Peppy and normal villagers get motherly warmth from her; patience and gentle talk earn a loyal, soft-spoken friend who rarely stays angry long.

lucky.appearance: Lucky is a black dog wrapped in white bandages like a full-body cast, mummy-soft and slightly uncanny. A glowing yellow left eye shines through the wrappings, with ears and tail peeking out the same pale wrap.
lucky.personality: Lucky's lazy calm makes him instantly approachable — food jokes, gentle naivete, and unhurried friendship that never feels performative. Peppy, smug, and cranky villagers usually mesh with his humor; snooty and jock personalities may clash with his slow lifestyle and love of rest. He sleeps at eleven and wakes at eight, bandaged and unbothered, glowing yellow eye steady through every season.

maple.appearance: Maple is a brown bear cub with cream-colored muzzle, hands, and feet, soft bangs, black nose, and pink blush on her cheeks. Earlier designs shrank her eyes and shifted her muzzle tan; New Horizons gives her dark brown eyebrows and a red ribbon tied at the back of her head, cozy as a storybook cub.
maple.personality: Maple embodies normal calm — kind, caring, easily upset by lazy misunderstandings and cranky scheming that misleads her in conversation. Fishing and bug catching keep her gently active without turning hobbies into competition. House visits may come with apologies for mess she shares with other normal villagers who worry their homes look unclean. In older games she mentions Moppina, a mop friend reflecting her tidy streak and quiet hygiene concerns. Peppy and normal neighbors feel sisterly in talk; snooty and smug villagers appreciate her good nature, though lazy food chatter can accidentally offend when she tries to be helpful. Patience and kindness unlock a neighbor who wants everyone's day a little softer, offering steady warmth once trust is earned over many unhurried visits and gentle favors.

marina.appearance: Marina is a pink octopus with round yellow cheeks, black eyes that shrink to smaller white pupils when shocked, a tuft of hair on her forehead, and a pink bow perched on the back of her head like a gentle accessory.
marina.personality: Marina's normal gentleness once read dreamy on the islands — aura comments, wandering thoughts, meditation requests, and furniture aimed at harmony and tranquility. She meditated often, lost in fanciful outlooks that could turn mystical or gently nonsensical, yet always kind when dealing with neighbors she met along the shore. In town life she is friendly and motherly, apologetic when asking favors, easy to befriend, and uneasy around cranky or snooty edges that clash with her spacey calm. Kindness is her default; even eccentric tangents feel sincere rather than performative, and she keeps a very kind personality through every season on your island, daydreams intact and gentle.

marshal.appearance: Marshal is a white squirrel with pink cheeks, pastel purple inner ears, slanted eyes and a small frown reminiscent of Static's older look before redesign. New Horizons gives him dark green eyes where earlier games used black; cream tips his hands, feet, and tail swirl — marshmallow-soft all over, down to the puffy silhouette.
marshal.personality: Marshal's smug charm is polite, lively, and faintly flirtatious with any neighbor he likes, player included regardless of gender. He can sound conceited when monologuing to himself, yet greets house visits with enthusiasm and enjoys the usual hobbies alongside an unseen love of dancing. He wakes at seven and sleeps at two — tidy, confident, quick to converse, and rarely at a loss for a compliment or a poised remark.

merengue.appearance: Merengue is a pink rhino with white hooves and hair, a red horn spotted in dark red and ringed by green semicircles — strawberry-sweet from tip to toe.
merengue.personality: Merengue's normal hospitality is warm and open about hobbies without strong opinions either way, friendly toward the player and easy with most neighbors. Cleanliness matters to her; she mentions hygiene when guests arrive and shares the unseen obsession many normal villagers carry. Lazy villagers who ramble about food may accidentally trigger dinner offers she did not plan, leading conversations into cozy meals. Most neighbors find her easy company — hospitable, neutral on hobbies, and gentle when talk turns domestic.

molly.appearance: Molly is a mallard duck with black oval eyes, golden-yellow beak, and dark brown markings atop the beak like a little crown. White belly, yellow striped legs, brown wings and head markings, and round pink cheeks finish a gentle pond-side look.
molly.personality: Molly's normal heart is sweet and motherly — watering-can kindness to flowers and neighbors alike, always checking whether someone needs help. She talks about books she enjoys with genuine delight and fusses over home cleanliness with loving anxiety, worrying her space never looks quite right to guests. Easy to befriend, she makes new islands feel tended and calm, offering hospitality that lands soft rather than fussy once you know her rhythm.

octavian.appearance: Octavian is a light red octopus with a jet piece standing in for a puckered mouth, puffy peach-pink cheek marks, and angry squinted eyes beneath sharp brows that give him a serious, profound expression. Two bandages cross the back of his head in an X; suckered tentacle arms and six legs make eight limbs total, true to a real octopus. Star-pattern shirts and lunar home decor nod to sci-fi Martian octopi from classic horror fiction — aliens common in Japanese pop culture — and his description leans into extraterrestrial roots, a cranky neighbor dressed like he stepped off a vintage poster for the stars.
octavian.personality: Octavian opens cranky-cold — rude edges that soften when the player keeps showing up kind, doing favors and talking often enough to earn trust. Near the beach he sometimes grows quiet, the sea stirring memories of parents and younger days he rarely shares aloud, a rare glimpse beneath the scowl.

poppy.appearance: Poppy is a red squirrel with cream muzzle, tail stripe, and paw tips. Turquoise fills her inner ears; an orange nose brightens her friendly face.
poppy.personality: Poppy's normal warmth is steady friendliness — sweet, hospitable, rarely angry even when startled, though meanness can leave her downcast. She mother hens the player and neighbors with gentle talk that makes small moments feel cared for.

raymond.appearance: Raymond is a gray office-cat fantasy — black tail, paws, and ears with pink insides, blonde hair combed neatly to the right, round glasses, and heterochromia with a green left eye and brown right. His house, catchphrase, and picture quote all wink at white-collar routine, a villager dressed for spreadsheets, espresso, and polished first impressions at the plaza.
raymond.personality: Raymond's smug poise is polite and animated — easy conversation, occasional flirting regardless of gender, and bursts of self-confidence when he mutters to himself about looking sharp. He enjoys the usual hobbies with enthusiasm when visitors arrive, though conceited asides slip out now and then. Without town ordinances he sleeps at two and rises at seven, always groomed for the day ahead.

rosie.appearance: Rosie is cerulean blue with darker blue hair and fur, big pie-eyed symbols angled as if glancing off to the right — cross when angry or sad, pointed in opposite directions when moods shift. Pink blush warms her cheeks; white tips her paws, tail, feet, and ears while inner ears fade pink to light pink. No nose shows, yet her curly smile carries all the expression she needs, hence the rosy name.
rosie.personality: Rosie shines peppy-bright — gifts, compliments, quick forgiveness, and moods that flip fast over tiny slights before she forgets them. Snooty and cranky gossip stings; she may feel insulted when style or tone turns sharp. Lazy neighbors can feel mismatched while jocks get her cheer in return, the male mirror to her energy. Normal, big sister, and smug villagers round out her easy friendships with warmth she hands out freely. Show up with kindness and she becomes one of the villagers who makes the plaza feel like a daily celebration, rewarding friends with praise and little surprises.

sasha.appearance: Sasha is a mint-green rabbit with white-tipped ears, feet, and muzzle, a sunny yellow tail, and blond bangs on his forehead. Round dark blue eyes hold sparkles; a tiny eyelash sticks from each outer corner. Orange inner ears and shocked gray pupils with deep blue centers finish a look that feels freshly minted and camera-ready.
sasha.personality: Sasha keeps lazy ease — friendly, food-loving, gently humorous, and slow to take offense even when talk turns silly. Peppy, smug, and cranky villagers usually get along with his relaxed pace; snooty and jock personalities may clash with naps and snacks that define his days. Eleven to eight is his sleep cycle, unhurried as his greeting, with naivete that reads charming rather than careless once you know him.

scoot.appearance: Scoot is a green duck with pink cheeks, determined eyes, and white headgear marked 1–5 like a Japanese swimming cap — numbering that suggests second class of first grade or first-year high school depending on hallway context at a typical school. The cap gag pairs with an indoor-pool home theme; New Horizons lightens his green slightly and widens his eyes compared to earlier outings on the plaza path.
scoot.personality: Scoot carries jock energy — sports talk, fitness pride, friendly nudges about exercise, and comments on the player's stamina with earnest bravado. Peppy and smug villagers match his pace; snooty neighbors bristle at critiques of their routines, and cranky villagers tire of hype that never quite winds down. While often friendly, his hyper personality can annoy quieter types until they see the encouragement beneath it. He sleeps around half past midnight and wakes at half past six, cap on, ready to lap the plaza before breakfast.

sherb.appearance: Sherb is a pale blue goat with a deeper blue tuft of hair leaning left, gray-striped horns, pale gray hooves, and large slanted black pupils that give him a gentle upward gaze. Coral pink nose and cheeks, pale orange inner ears, and a three-shaped mouth connect nose to smile in one soft line. Like Kidd he skips the beard — youthful next to other male goats, fleece bright as winter sky on cold island mornings ahead.
sherb.personality: Sherb drifts through island days with lazy warmth — snacks, jokes, gentle naivete, and friendly hellos that make mornings feel slower in the best way. Peppy, smug, and cranky neighbors usually suit him; snooty and jock villagers may side-eye his slow rhythm and love of food talk. Eleven to eight keeps his schedule as soft as his fleece, with humor that lands lightly even when he sounds absent-minded.

shino.appearance: Shino is a cream-white deer with a white muzzle, small fangs, gold hooves, and ears and tail that fade to light gray at the tips. Elongated eyeshadow and eyebrows styled like a Noh mask shape her expression into something theatrical; two red horns curve from her forehead in kabuki fashion. Tusks and antler hints nod to musk deer lore — she is the only female deer villager with horns on her head.
shino.personality: Shino glows peppy — cheerful gifts, fast moods, short memory for spats, and easy friendship for neighbors who match her festival energy. Snooty and cranky barbs hurt when gossip turns personal; lazy neighbors can feel awkward in pace while jocks, smug villagers, big sister types, and fellow peppy neighbors keep her alight with shared sparkle. She may overreact to small things yet forgives quickly, handing out compliments and presents to those she trusts most on the island, bright as the mask-inspired poise she wears every day on the plaza. Loyal neighbors find her warmth festival-bright.

stitches.appearance: Stitches looks sewn from a child's toy — bear cub patchwork with a bright purple forehead and tail, orange face and body, X-shaped eyes, and mismatched ears where the left runs blue and light green and the right dark green and orange. Limbs each wear their own color: dark green left arm, blue right arm, dark orange left leg, light green right leg. White muzzle, bear smile, and white stomach complete the hug-ready design fans recognize instantly.
stitches.personality: Stitches lives lazy-sweet — unhurried friendship, food chatter, soft humor, and easy bonds with peppy, smug, and cranky neighbors who appreciate his mellow pace. Snooty and jock villagers may clash with his nap-first philosophy and snack-loving jokes. Eleven to eight is his rhythm; every hello feels like settling into a well-loved chair, naive in the gentlest sense.

tangy.appearance: Tangy is an orange cat shaped like citrus — a green leaf on her head similar to Tank's style, pink inner ears, and southeast-angled eyes that turn cross-eyed when she looks up or down. Small indents pock her body like peel texture; tangerine, clementine, and orange notes explain her name in one sunny glance.
tangy.personality: Tangy stays peppy-upbeat — good moods, easy befriending, cute bugs and fish requests, and magazine daydreams shared with other stylish villagers who read unseen fashion pages. She jokes about feeling bloated after absurd snacking, flares up fast, then forgets why, attention span short as her temper is quick. Fame fantasies pop up now and then, dreams of spotlight she shares with peppy neighbors who chase the same glitter. Normal, lazy, and peppy villagers suit her; snooty and cranky types groan at the sparkle she refuses to dim. Short fuse, shorter grudge — she keeps the island tasting bright through every season ahead.

whitney.appearance: Whitney is a white wolf — possibly arctic — with blue eyes, a red-brown nose, and a wavy tuft of fur on her forehead. Pink inner ears, pink eyeshadow with winged liner, precisely shaped eyebrows, and a long spiky tail finish the look. Older games used purple eyes and a deeper brown nose before her current palette settled in.
whitney.personality: Whitney wears snooty elegance — classy, chic, and quick to critique outfits or manners when talk turns to fashion. Cranky, big sister, smug, and fellow snooty villagers share her wavelength; jocks challenge her fitness and normal villagers' relentless politeness can irritate her sharper tastes. Under the polish is someone who notices detail and expects effort, belittling only until respect is mutual.

zucker.appearance: Zucker is an octopus built like takoyaki — round red head freckled green like seasoning on the ball, bamboo toothpick skewering the top, sauce-like hair dripping over the side, and black oval eyes that flash white with black rims when shocked. His body red matches Octavian's family tone, snack-stall cute and villager-soft at once on the beach.
zucker.personality: Zucker keeps lazy ease — friendly hellos, food on the mind, gentle humor, and patience with most neighbors who share his unhurried rhythm. Peppy, smug, and cranky villagers usually mesh with his jokes; snooty and jock personalities may clash with his snack-and-rest lifestyle and love of comfort. Eleven to eight is his schedule, takoyaki warmth in every greeting he offers across the plaza.
